summary: Frontend E2E validation of the SHORT demo (/demo?lang=es) after applying the same enhancements the long demo already had. All 7 review items verified green: (1) Spanish step bar shows exactly 'Tus datos / El trabajo / Cotización / Contrato / Factura'; (2) full flow lead->describe->AI quote (~5-8s)->accept->AGREEMENT is INSTANT (measured 0.04s, no 'Preparing your agreement…' wait); (3) sign->INVOICE->pay->demo-paid-block appear; (4) FinalCTA points to /register?plan=bundle and demo-flow-final-whatsapp button exists; (5) whatsapp-fab visible throughout; (6) Register with plan=bundle redirects to real Stripe test checkout (cs_test_b1KNmDhd7r8bS9HRZW...); (7) /admin/demo shows demo-variant-toggle with both demo-variant-flujo & demo-variant-corto; switching to 'corto' shows the 5-step funnel with EXACT expected labels 'Vio el demo (datos) / Describió el trabajo / Cotización con IA / Contrato / Acuerdo / Factura + Pago'. After our E2E, corto KPIs correctly show +1 completed session (2 sesiones, 1 terminaron 100%, Techos/Roofing 100%).

critical_code_review_comments: React key warning in console: 'Encountered two children with the same key d_ms6qoai1_1nqy3uv0' when rendering admin demo analytics — likely two demo_sessions rows with the same session_id across variants or duplicate rows on the recent sessions list. Non-blocking but should dedupe keys (e.g., key={`${variant}-${session_id}-${idx}`}).

DemoFlow's LeadStep validates only name+email; phone and trade are technically optional per code but the review request lists them as required inputs — consider marking phone/trade required with client-side validation to keep leads high-quality.
